title: NEST STEP — A bedroom system for growing independence, 14 deliverables

# NEST STEP

- Product: children's bed, bedside storage and caregiver bench system
- Fixed printed name: NEST STEP
- Fixed printed phrase: Room to grow
- Growth stages: ages 4–6; ages 7–10
- Household planning height ranges: 1000–1200 mm; 1200–1450 mm, respectively
- Shared mattress: 1900 × 900 × 120 mm
- Furniture material: 18 mm birch plywood
- Furniture finish: clear water-based lacquer
- Exposed edge radius: R5 mm
- Bed connections: 16 M6 button-head bolts with barrel nuts
- Bed assembly tool: 4 mm hex key
- Cabinet and bench connections: glued dowels
- Maximum dismantled furniture part envelope: 2000 × 1000 × 450 mm

## Assembly inventory

| ID | Assembly | Quantity | Fixed dimensions or identity |
|---|---|---:|---|
| B1 | Bed frame | 1 | Outer footprint 1980 × 980 mm |
| P1 | Mattress platform | 1 | Top height 180 mm or 300 mm |
| G1–G2 | Solid side guards | 2 | Each 1100 mm long; top 350 mm above mattress; aligned with mattress head |
| C1 | Bedside cabinet | 1 | 600 × 320 × 600 mm, width × depth × height |
| S1 | Caregiver bench | 1 | 700 × 350 × 420 mm, width × depth × height |
| T1–T2 | Existing canvas bins | 2 | Each 300 × 240 × 180 mm, width × depth × height; sage cotton canvas; two loop handles |

## Stage geometry

| Mattress top above floor | 300 mm | 420 mm |
| Guard top above floor | 650 mm | 770 mm |
| Entry length toward mattress foot | 800 mm | 800 mm |
| Guard quantity in use | 2 | 2 |
| Bin location | Both under caregiver bench | One on each cabinet shelf |
| Cabinet shelf top heights | 120 and 360 mm | 120 and 360 mm |
| Assembly inventory total | 8 | 8 |

## Room

- Internal dimensions: 3200 × 3600 mm
- Coordinate origin: southwest internal corner
- X axis: east; Y axis: north
- South-wall door opening: X = 0–800 mm
- Door hinge: southwest corner; inward swing toward west wall
- North-wall window: X = 900–2300 mm; sill 900 mm above floor
- Fixed wardrobe footprint: X = 2600–3200 mm; Y = 1200–3000 mm
- Wardrobe access face: west; sliding doors
- Clear route from room door to bed entry: 750 mm

steps.userMessage:
NEST STEP | A bedroom system for growing independence

We are developing NEST STEP for families adapting a child's bedroom from shared bedtime routines to independent dressing and tidying. Build one system for two stages: ages 4–6 and ages 7–10. Both stages use the same 1900 × 900 × 120 mm mattress and eight assemblies: one bed frame, one mattress platform, two solid side guards, one bedside cabinet, one caregiver bench and two existing canvas bins. The bins are the starting point for the storage design; retain their sage fabric, rectangular shape and paired loop handles.

The room measures 3200 × 3600 mm, with its door, window and wardrobe fixed as recorded in the attachments. Maintain a 750 mm clear route from the door to the bed's entry. The bed's outer footprint is 1980 × 980 mm. Set the platform top at 180 mm in the younger stage and 300 mm in the older stage. Each side guard is 1100 mm long, starts at the mattress head and reaches 350 mm above the mattress top, leaving an 800 mm entry toward the foot. Both guards remain in use at both stages. The cabinet measures 600 × 320 × 600 mm and the bench 700 × 350 × 420 mm, in width × depth × height. In the younger stage, the bins sit under the bench beside the caregiver; in the older stage, they occupy two cabinet shelves with tops at 120 and 360 mm above the floor.

Use 18 mm birch plywood with clear water-based lacquer for the furniture, exposed edges rounded to R5 mm, and 16 M6 button-head bolts with barrel nuts for the bed assembly, operated with a 4 mm hex key. The cabinet and bench use glued dowel joints. Each dismantled furniture part fits within 2000 × 1000 × 450 mm. Print "NEST STEP" and "Room to grow" on the specification sheet, hero image, video title card and presentation cover.

Audience: families, our product team and the furniture workshop, for choosing the room arrangement and developing the first sample.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the fixed product facts. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists delivery proportions, formats and stages. 03-household-records.md records the room boundaries, growth stages, household objects and care activities. room-and-growth-plan.png supplies the fixed room geometry and stage dimensions. existing-canvas-bins.png establishes the two storage objects retained throughout the system. bedtime-care-reference.png provides atmosphere for shared reading and bedside care. independent-tidying-reference.png provides atmosphere for child-led sorting and dressing.

Deliverables:
1. A one-page specification and state inventory covering eight assemblies, materials, connections, both platform heights and the position of every assembly in each stage
2. One exploded system overview identifying all eight assemblies and the 16 bed fasteners
3. Two dimensioned room layouts, one per age stage, with the door swing, wardrobe, 750 mm route, bed entry and positions of all eight assemblies
4. Three orthographic drawing sheets: bed with both platform and guard positions; cabinet with its two bin shelves; bench with its two-bin storage space
5. Two detail sheets: bed connections and adjustment sequence; guard ends, entry and R5 mm contact edges
6. Two furnished use scenes: younger-stage bedtime care and older-stage independent tidying, with the household objects in their assigned places
7. One system hero image showing the older-stage furniture and both existing bins
8. One 10-second transformation video showing the platform and guards changing height and the two bins moving from bench to cabinet
9. One presentation document of at least 10 pages, reusing the specification, exploded overview, layouts, drawings, details, scenes and hero image

Acceptance:
- The specification, exploded overview and presentation identify the same eight assemblies, 18 mm birch plywood with clear water-based lacquer, and 16 M6 bed bolts with barrel nuts; the connection detail locates all 16 bolts and shows the 4 mm hex key sequence.
- Both room layouts retain the 3200 × 3600 mm room and the recorded door, window and wardrobe positions; dimensions show a continuous 750 mm clear route to the 800 mm bed entry.
- The bed drawing, contact detail and presentation repeat the 1900 × 900 × 120 mm mattress, 1980 × 980 mm bed footprint, 180 and 300 mm platform heights, and 1100 mm guards rising 350 mm above the mattress; the contact detail dimensions the R5 mm exposed edges.
- The cabinet and bench drawings accommodate two 300 × 240 × 180 mm bins in the specified younger and older positions; both scenes and the hero preserve the bins' sage fabric and paired loop handles, with every object from the household records assigned a visible storage or use location.
- The transformation video lasts 10 seconds and follows the specification's two states, retaining all eight assemblies; the connection detail and presentation identify the largest dismantled part and dimension it within 2000 × 1000 × 450 mm.
- The specification, hero, video title card and presentation cover print NEST STEP and Room to grow; the presentation contains at least 10 pages and reuses all seven earlier work categories named in its deliverable.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
